# potato

The goal of potato is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of potato from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jeffkimbrel/potato")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(potato)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`?
You can include R chunks like so:

``` r

summary(cars)
#>      speed           dist       
#>  Min.   : 4.0   Min.   :  2.00  
#>  1st Qu.:12.0   1st Qu.: 26.00  
#>  Median :15.0   Median : 36.00  
#>  Mean   :15.4   Mean   : 42.98  
#>  3rd Qu.:19.0   3rd Qu.: 56.00  
#>  Max.   :25.0   Max.   :120.00
```

You’ll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md`
up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

![](reference/figures/README-pressure-1.png)

In that case, don’t forget to commit and push the resulting figure
files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.

# Package index

## Setup

Initialize sacks and load potatoes

- [`initialize_potato_sack()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/initialize_potato_sack.md)
  : Initialize a new potato sack project
- [`create_sack()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/create_sack.md)
  : Create a PotatoSack from project directory
- [`find_potato_sack()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/find_potato_sack.md)
  : Find the root of a potato sack project
- [`add_genomes()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/add_genomes.md)
  : Add genomes to a potato sack
- [`load_potato_v2()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/load_potato_v2.md)
  : Load potato v2 schema
- [`load_potatoes()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/load_potatoes.md)
  : Load multiple potatoes from directory
- [`load_potato_config()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/load_potato_config.md)
  : Load potato configuration from YAML

## Annotation

Run annotation tools

- [`run_kofam()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/run_kofam.md)
  : Run kofam annotation on all genomes
- [`run_blast()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/run_blast.md)
  : Run BLAST annotation on all genomes
- [`run_hmm()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/run_hmm.md)
  : Run HMM annotation on all genomes
- [`create_kofam_hal()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/create_kofam_hal.md)
  : Create .hal file for kofam from potato KO list
- [`create_blast_db()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/create_blast_db.md)
  : Create filtered BLAST database from potato reference sequences
- [`create_hmm_profile()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/create_hmm_profile.md)
  : Create filtered HMM profile file from potato detection terms

## Scoring

Score pathway presence/absence

- [`score_pathways()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/score_pathways.md)
  : Score pathway presence/absence across all genomes
- [`get_pathway_scores()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_pathway_scores.md)
  : Get pathway-level scoring results
- [`get_gene_results()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_gene_results.md)
  : Get gene-level annotation results

## Analysis

Analyze results

- [`summarize_missing_genes()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/summarize_missing_genes.md)
  : Identify genes missing across genomes
- [`find_near_miss_pathways()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/find_near_miss_pathways.md)
  : Find pathways that are close to being called present
- [`inspect_gene_thresholds()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/inspect_gene_thresholds.md)
  : Inspect gene-level annotation hits and thresholds

## Visualization

Plot pathways and results

- [`plot_v2()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/plot_v2.md)
  : Simple plot of v2 graph
- [`plot_v2_interactive()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/plot_v2_interactive.md)
  : Interactive visNetwork plot of v2 graph
- [`view_pathway_detail()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/view_pathway_detail.md)
  : View pathway details as HTML table in browser
- [`plot_all_pathways_heatmap()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/plot_all_pathways_heatmap.md)
  : Plot comprehensive pathway completion heatmap across all genomes
- [`plot_annotation_coverage()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/plot_annotation_coverage.md)
  : Plot annotation coverage heatmap
- [`plot_pathway_prevalence()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/plot_pathway_prevalence.md)
  : Plot pathway prevalence across genomes
- [`plot_pathway_uniqueness()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/plot_pathway_uniqueness.md)
  : Plot pathway uniqueness distribution
- [`update_potato_coordinates()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/update_potato_coordinates.md)
  : Update potato JSON with node coordinates
- [`align_coordinates()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/align_coordinates.md)
  : Align node coordinates to grid or by axis
- [`potato_theme()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/potato_theme.md)
  : POTATO plot theme

## Utilities

Helper functions

- [`get_kegg_url()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_kegg_url.md)
  : Generate KEGG URL for a specific pathway
- [`get_pathway_verification()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_pathway_verification.md)
  : Get simple pathway verification status table
- [`get_verification_status()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_verification_status.md)
  : Get verification status of pathways
- [`print_potato()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/print_potato.md)
  : Print potato structure as text
- [`print_provenance()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/print_provenance.md)
  : Print provenance summary
- [`get_potato_hashes()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_potato_hashes.md)
  : Get potato hashes for multiple potatoes
- [`compute_potato_hash()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/compute_potato_hash.md)
  : Compute MD5 hash of potato R object

## Validation

Validate potatoes and configs

- [`validate_potato()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/validate_potato.md)
  : Validate potato structure
- [`validate_multi_pathway()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/validate_multi_pathway.md)
  : Validate multi-pathway network potato (V2 schema)
- [`validate_database_configs()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/validate_database_configs.md)
  : Validate database configurations

## Classes

S7 object classes

- [`PotatoSack()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/PotatoSack.md)
  : Potato Sack S7 Class
- [`PotatoV2()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/PotatoV2.md)
  : PotatoV2 S7 class
- [`Potato()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/Potato.md)
  : Potato S7 Class
- [`GenomeFile()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/GenomeFile.md)
  : Genome File S7 Class

## Graph utilities

Internal graph building

- [`build_graph_v2()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/build_graph_v2.md)
  : Build igraph from v2 potato
- [`get_enzyme_nodes()`](https://jeffkimbrel.github.io/potato/reference/get_enzyme_nodes.md)
  : Get enzyme nodes from potato

## Exclude S7 internal methods
